evaluations.output:
```lua
localParticle = {}
Particle.__index =Particle

functionParticle.new(pos, vel, acc)
    local self = setmetatable({},Particle)
    self.pos = pos or 0.0
    self.vel = vel or 0.0
    self.acc = acc or 0.0
    return self
end

functionParticle:update(dt)
    self.vel = self.vel + self.acc * dt
    self.pos = self.pos + self.vel * dt
    return self
end

returnParticle
```
